setup.hint: Enter the server address, e.g. {example1} or {example2}. Without a scheme, https:// is tried first.

settings.title: Settings
settings.insecure: Not encrypted (http://) — use https:// outside your home network
settings.signOutDesc: Clear your session on this TV. The server URL is kept so you can sign in again with the same account.
settings.forgetServerDesc: Remove the server URL and all session state. Use when switching to a different OnScreen deployment.
settings.forcedOn: On — only show subtitles flagged as forced
settings.qualityNote: Limits for your account on every device: anything above them is converted by the server.
settings.scrobbleAllDesc: Send the music you play to ListenBrainz or Last.fm, and the movies and episodes you watch to Trakt.
settings.scrobbleLbDesc: Submit a listen to ListenBrainz when you finish a music track.
settings.privacyDesc: Scan the code with your phone, or open this address on a phone or computer:
settings.legalDesc: Terms of use, the app's Apache 2.0 licence and third-party notices.
settings.diagnosticsDesc: What this console can play, and what the controller sends.
settings.signOutBody: You'll need to sign in again to continue using OnScreen on this TV.
settings.forgetBody: This removes the server URL and all session state. You'll start over from the server-URL prompt.
prefs.langSaveReverted: Couldn't save the language. Showing what the server has.
prefs.qualitySaveInvalid: The server didn't accept that setting.
scrobble.title: Scrobbling
scrobble.timedOut: The {service} approval wasn't finished in time. Connect again to retry.
scrobble.lbAbout: When you finish a music track, OnScreen submits a listen to your ListenBrainz account. A play counts once you're past half the track, or four minutes — whichever comes first. One-way and best-effort: it never reads anything back and never affects playback.
scrobble.lbStep1: On a phone or computer, open {address} and copy your {token}.
scrobble.lbLinkedOn: Your ListenBrainz account is linked and listens are being submitted.
scrobble.lbLinkedPaused: A token is linked but scrobbling is currently off. Replace the token to re-enable it.
scrobble.lbTokenNote: Your token is stored encrypted and is never shown again. Unlinking removes it.
scrobble.lastfmAbout: Finished tracks are scrobbled to your Last.fm profile — same rule as above, half the track or four minutes — and the track you're playing shows as scrobbling now.
scrobble.lastfmRevoke: Disconnecting forgets the link here. To revoke OnScreen's access on Last.fm too, remove it under Settings › Applications on last.fm.
scrobble.lastfmMissing: Last.fm isn't set up on this server. An admin adds a Last.fm API account in the web app's Settings.
scrobble.traktAbout: Movies and episodes you watch are scrobbled to your Trakt history: a play that reaches 80% counts as watched, and a paused one keeps its progress there. While something plays, your profile shows it.
scrobble.traktRevoke: Disconnecting also revokes OnScreen's access on Trakt.
scrobble.traktMissing: Trakt isn't set up on this server. An admin adds a Trakt API app in the web app's Settings.
scrobble.traktScan: Scan the code, or on any phone or computer go to
scrobble.lastfmScan: Scan the code with your phone to open Last.fm, then allow OnScreen access to your account.
scrobble.lastfmOrOpen: Or open this address on a phone or computer:
scrobble.lastfmWaiting: Waiting for Last.fm… This finishes on its own once you allow access.
